note: Upcoming events that tend to spark memecoin themes. Researched from news on the date above; dates can move. strength: 1 = niche, 2 = big online moment, 3 = mainstream / worldwide.

events.title: Thanksgiving and Black Friday (US)
events.why: Food and holiday memes appear every year, but US traders are offline, so volume is usually thin.

events.title: Spotify Wrapped 2026 (expected date)
events.why: Everyone posts their Wrapped on the same day, so the year's top artists trend everywhere. Still not confirmed by Spotify; the last five editions dropped on a Wednesday in early December.

events.title: US Fed rate decision (hike expected)
events.why: Markets price a 25 bps rate hike at over 90% after hot inflation data, and Bitcoin has already slid. Not a theme to launch into: memecoin risk appetite can stay weak for days around the decision.

events.title: The Game Awards
events.why: GTA 6 leads with eight nominations including Game of the Year, so a second wave of GTA hype three weeks after launch.

events.title: 'Dunesday': Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three
events.why: Two of the biggest films of the year open the same day, with Doomsday tracking for a record opening. Villain and Dune names (Doom, Spice, Shai-Hulud) are easy meme picks.

events.title: Christmas, plus 'Artificial' (the Sam Altman film) and Jumanji 3
events.why: Santa and holiday tokens appear every December. The Sam Altman film opens in limited release on Christmas Day, adding an AI angle, and Jumanji 3 is reported to have moved to the same day.

events.title: New Year 2027
events.why: Year-number and fireworks tokens pop up every New Year, and traders come back from the holidays looking for the next theme.

events.title: CES 2027 (Las Vegas)
events.why: The biggest yearly tech show, packed with AI gadgets and robots. Viral robot and AI-device clips from the show floor often turn into tokens.

fading.why: The Trump memecoin hit record lows after the midterm results. Political tokens are losing attention.
GTA 6 tokens like DacityCoin spiked around launch and then fell sharply; the GTA meta is cooling until The Game Awards.
